ACT_1.secondary: The Federal Power Act tasks a federal commission with overseeing electricity sales that cross state lines. (TX-01)
The two words the utilities were reading. Federal jurisdiction is not really a pricing power - it is the authority to say how a system must be run, and to come and check. (TX-02)
If no power crossed a state line, the sale was not interstate commerce, and the federal government could not regulate their rates or operations. (TX-02)
The policy of isolation was put into an agreement among the utilities, binding themselves to intrastate operation. (TX-03)
A cascading failure takes out much of the north-eastern United States, and the country decides grids need somebody watching them. (TX-04)
ERCOT is formed, five years after that blackout - and deliberately outside the reach of the federal regulator. (TX-04)

_readme: EVERY CARD CARRIES ITS LEDGER ROW ID. A card sits on screen longer than a sentence is spoken
and reads as the film's own voice, so none of them asserts anything the ledger does not.
THE FIVE QUARANTINE RULES SHAPE THIS SET DIRECTLY:
⛔-02 the grid did NOT collapse. ACT_3 therefore carries a card that says so in terms, next
to the measured margin. A near-miss is a number here, never an adjective.
⛔-03 no single fuel villain. The 43.3 / 21.5 split is carded verbatim and a second card
states that outages happened ACROSS fuel types. No turbine appears in the typography at
all -- the film shows one, once, and the cards do not reinforce it.
⛔-01 winterization was RECOMMENDED, not required. 'A RECOMMENDATION IS NOT A STANDARD' is a
card of its own in ACT_2, and the penalty range in ACT_5 answers it eleven years later
in dollars per day. Those two cards are a pair and should not be separated.
⛔-04 246 is the only toll stated as fact -- one stat card. The contested estimate is carded
with the word 'estimate' and without adopting it.
⛔-06 no single economic figure. Both ranges on one card, neither adopted.
THE TURN OF THE FILM IS ACT_4's kinetic card, THE GAS FIELDS / WERE NOT ON IT. It is the only
place the typography raises its voice, and it lands on the sentence the whole film is built
around (TX-17).
BANNED FIGURE KINDS: no dochighlight -- the black bar / box / underline figure reads as a
rendering artefact; the owner flagged it on EP40, EP41 and EP42 and it is barred from PD
film.json. No DATE_STAMP. Kinds used: lowerthird, kinetic, stat.
